properties.name: Syabru Besi North Ridge Haven
properties.why_safe: 128m above peak river surge; slope 6.2° (landslide-safe bedrock bench); direct paved road access; 100% dry across 30-year satellite flood history.

properties.name: Dhunche Hospital Safe Plateau
properties.why_safe: 680m high plateau above the canyon; adjacent to District Hospital with backup diesel generators; direct highway access; zero historical flood risk.

properties.name: Bidur Higher Ground Sports Terrace
properties.why_safe: 110m above flooded Trishuli confluence; large flat stadium terrace (slope 3.8°); immediate two-lane road connectivity; ideal helicopter & relief staging point.

properties.name: Betrawati Upper Agricultural Terraces
properties.why_safe: 140m elevation margin over flooded river junctions; gentle agricultural stepped terrace (slope 7.1°); well above flood-surge erosion zones.

properties.name: Devighat High Ridge Safe Haven
properties.why_safe: 130m above flooded Taadi Khola & Trishuli confluence; broad granite-founded ridge; dry feeder road to Galchi highway.

properties.name: Timure Customs Upper Plateau
properties.why_safe: 101m above river canyon; elevated above narrow gorge debris line; secure concrete-paved depot compound.

properties.name: Dandagaun Viewpoint Safe Haven
properties.why_safe: 180m high overlook; safe stable soil profile; connected via dry hillside paved link road.

properties.name: Mailung Upper Slope Evacuation Site
properties.why_safe: 180m above riverbed; situated above landslide fan deposits; connects to Upper Trishuli access road.
